keyFindings.description: listenerTakeoverWindow is a const, so every existing api test whose send meets 'no live session', a refused connection or a 503 now sleeps the full 12 s. Sixteen tests that exist on main went from 13 s to about 214 s together, and the package now runs past go test's 10-minute default on CI: envoy-go failed with 'panic: test timed out after 10m0s' at code head 125a3bfb. Make the window a variable that a test can set short, as DeliveryResumeInterval and the route-roster TTL already are, and keep 12 s only in the tests that prove the window itself. Show internal/dispatch/api back near main's time, and envoy-go green on CI.
